test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A cyclist covers a distance of 2.5 km in 4 minutes 10 seconds. How long will he take to cover a distance of 6 km at the same speed?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered = 2.5 km

Time taken = 4 minutes 10 seconds = 4 + 10/60 = 4 + 1/6 = 25/6 minutes

New distance = 6 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Speed = 2.5 / (25/6)

Speed = 2.5 × 6 / 25

Speed = 15 / 25

Speed = 3 / 5 km/min

Time to cover 6 km = Distance / Speed

Time to cover 6 km = 6 / (3/5)

Time to cover 6 km = 6 × 5 / 3

Time to cover 6 km = 30 / 3

Time to cover 6 km = 10 minutes

**Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.**
